name: Sports goods and fitness equipment retail

problems.words: Team kit orders come with names and numbers on WhatsApp and we print them wrong
quick_ideas: Get the coach to confirm the final list before printing, because most errors come from handwritten photos
Note the cause of last season's misprints, because it shows where mistakes begin.

workzap_build.text: the coach fills sizes, names and numbers through a link, approves a proof, and the kit is tracked from printing to delivery.

problems.ask_first: How many team orders come in a month?
problems.free_stops: the order form and proof-approval flow are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many team kit print mistakes came from chat screenshots versus typed lists this week, so the real source stands out.
Make one staff member keep one final print list for each team order, so old chat versions stop causing misprints.

problems.words: We always run out of middle sizes in shoes and jerseys
quick_ideas: Check which sizes sold out first last season, because it shows your real size curve
Order by that curve instead of equal sizes, because odd sizes are what get left.

workzap_build.text: size-matrix stock (style, size, colour) with reorder alerts by size.

problems.ask_first: How do you track sizes today?
problems.free_stops: the size curve and reorder rules go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how often middle shoe and jersey sizes are asked for after they are gone this week, so missed sales are clearer.
Give one person the job of noting middle size stock on one daily list, so reordering happens before shelves empty.

problems.words: Treadmill delivery and installation are scheduled on a paper diary
quick_ideas: Put every pending delivery on one list with the promised date, because late ones become visible
Have technicians report back after each fitting, because the shop often doesn't know it's done.

workzap_build.text: an installation scheduler with technician job cards, photos and customer sign-off on phone.

problems.ask_first: Who delivers and installs, your own team or outside?
problems.free_stops: scheduling rules and the sign-off flow are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare the promised date and actual visit date for each pending treadmill job this week, so late handovers are easy to spot.
Give one person one delivery diary page for all treadmill bookings and completed visits, so installers and shop staff stay aligned.

problems.words: Customers call about broken machines and service requests get lost
quick_ideas: List every open service request and warranty claim with its date, because it shows what's overdue
Make one person own service calls, because shared phones lose them.

workzap_build.text: a service and warranty tracker with brand claim status and customer updates.

problems.ask_first: Do you handle repairs or send them to the brand?
problems.free_stops: the service flow and claim tracking are detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many broken machine calls are still open from last week, so the service backlog becomes visible.
Give one person one notebook page for every broken machine call and service request, so callbacks stop getting lost.

problems.words: Gyms on AMC call and we don't know when the last visit was
quick_ideas: List every AMC customer with their last visit date, because it shows who is due
Note parts used on each visit, because it explains costs later.

workzap_build.text: an AMC register with visit schedule, parts used and reminders sent on schedule.

problems.ask_first: How many gyms are on AMC?
problems.free_stops: the visit planning setup is kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note each gym that called under contract and compare it with your last visit notes, so overdue sites are easier to see.
Give one staff member one page for contract visits and last visit dates, so incoming calls get answered with certainty.

problems.words: Schools and academies buy on credit and pay late
quick_ideas: Total what each institution owes and for how long, because it shows who to chase first
Agree credit limits before the season, because they're easier set early.

workzap_build.text: an institutional credit ledger with ageing and WhatsApp reminder messages sent to buyers.

problems.ask_first: How long do they usually take to pay?
problems.free_stops: limits and reminder timing go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many school and academy invoice files are missing a recent payment note, so handover work for collections becomes clearer.
Give one staff member one notebook for promised payment dates from schools and academies, so follow up calls happen at the same time each day.

problems.words: Cricket season stock arrives after the season starts
quick_ideas: Write down when last season's stock arrived against when you needed it, because it shows the real lead time
Order earlier for your biggest lines, because the season doesn't wait.

workzap_build.text: a seasonal buying planner from past sales by month, with order-by reminders.

problems.ask_first: Do you buy locally, from Sialkot, or import?
problems.free_stops: the buying calendar is worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Write the needed date beside the actual arrival date for seasonal cricket lines, so purchasing delay is measured clearly.
Give one person one preseason list of key cricket lines and needed dates, so buying is not left too late.

problems.words: Website shows items out of stock in the shop
quick_ideas: Check your top items across shop and online once, because it shows how far apart they are
Make one person own stock numbers, because otherwise nobody updates.

workzap_build.text: unified online and shop stock so sizes sold in one place disappear from the other.

problems.ask_first: Which online channels do you sell on?
problems.free_stops: channel connections are kept for the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare shelf stock with the shown stock for your fastest selling items once this week, so mismatches are easy to find.
Give one staff member one stock list to update after every sale and receipt, so shop and online numbers stay closer.

problems.words: Discounts given to coaches and clubs aren't tracked
quick_ideas: Review a month of discounts by customer type, because it shows what's really given away
Agree set rates for coaches and clubs, because case-by-case deals drift.

workzap_build.text: discount rules by customer type with approval above limits and a monthly report.

problems.free_stops: rates and approval routing go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many coach and club sales slips show a price change without a written reason, so unrecorded counter decisions become visible.
Give one counter person one page for every coach and club price exception this week, so the owner can review patterns without chasing staff.

problems.words: We can't tell which brand or category makes money
quick_ideas: Work out margin on your top few items including delivery, because heavy items often lose money
Separate delivery cost from the sale price, because it hides inside totals.

workzap_build.text: margin by brand and category including delivery, updated monthly.

problems.free_stops: the margin model is set up in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note the selling price and landed cost of your fastest moving lines by brand this week, so weaker categories stand out.
Give one staff member one notebook page for landed costs by brand and category, so pricing stops being guessed.

never_say: Any training, injury, fitness, supplement or nutrition advice.
Safety or liability judgements about equipment; if someone was injured, point to medical help or emergency services.
Advice on product safety certification; say "check with your adviser".
Help selling counterfeit branded goods or relabelling items.
Help with under-invoiced imports or fake invoices for clubs or schools.

sample_reply.person: Club ke kit orders WhatsApp pe haath se likhi list ki photo mein aate hain aur printing mein naam number ghalat ho jaate hain. Koi hal?
sample_reply.pi:
Bilkul, is ka hal mumkin hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, printing se pehle coach se final list confirm karwa lein, kyun ke zyada tar ghaltiyan haath se likhi photo se aati hain.
Doosra, pichle season ki ghalat printing ki wajah likh lein, taake pata chale ghalti kahan se shuru hoti hai.
Workzap is se aage ye kar sakta hai: coach ek link pe size, naam aur number bhare, proof approve kare aur kit printing se delivery tak track ho.

Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
